mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO asset (id, sn, model_id, idc_id, cabinet_id, cabinet_start, cabinet_end, host, state, purchase_date, create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by,ipmi) VALUES (NULL, #{asset.sn},#{asset.modelId},#{asset.idcId},#{asset.cabinetId},#{asset.cabinetStart},#{asset.cabinetEnd},#{asset.host}, #{asset.state},#{asset.purchaseDate},#{asset.createAt},#{asset.updateAt},#{asset.createBy},#{asset.updateBy},#{asset.ipmi})
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID();
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT( * ) total, m.NAME, sd1.value as vendor, sd2.value as assetType, a.state FROM asset a LEFT JOIN model m ON a.model_id = m.id LEFT JOIN sys_dict sd1 ON sd1.CODE = m.vendor AND sd1.type = 'vendor' LEFT JOIN sys_dict sd2 ON sd2.CODE = m.type AND sd2.type = 'assetType' GROUP BY a.model_id,a.state

SELECT count( * ) total, m.NAME , sd1.value as vendor, sd2.value as assetType FROM asset a LEFT JOIN asset_ping assp ON a.host = assp.host LEFT JOIN model m ON a.model_id = m.id LEFT JOIN sys_dict sd1 ON sd1.CODE = m.vendor AND sd1.type = 'vendor' LEFT JOIN sys_dict sd2 ON sd2.CODE = m.type AND sd2.type = 'assetType' WHERE assp.status = 1 GROUP BY a.model_id;

SELECT cha.id as chartId, ass.id, ass.sn, ass.host FROM chart cha LEFT JOIN panel pan ON cha.panel_id = pan.id LEFT JOIN asset ass ON pan.link = ass.id WHERE cha.id IN
#{id}
select idc_id as id,count(id) as total from asset group by idc_id
SELECT ass.model_id AS id, count( ass.id ) AS total FROM asset ass LEFT JOIN model mo ON ass.model_id = mo.id GROUP BY ass.model_id
SELECT ass.id, count( am.id ) AS total FROM asset ass LEFT JOIN alert_message am ON ass.id = am.asset_id WHERE am.state = 1 GROUP BY ass.id

SELECT assp.status FROM asset ass LEFT JOIN asset_ping assp ON ass.host = assp.host WHERE ass.id IN
#{id}
SELECT ass.*, asst.tag AS asst_tag, asst.value AS asst_value FROM asset ass LEFT JOIN asset_tag asst ON ass.id = asst.asset_id WHERE ass.id = #{assetId}
SELECT ass.*, asst.tag AS asst_tag, asst.value AS asst_value FROM asset ass LEFT JOIN asset_tag asst ON ass.id = asst.asset_id WHERE ass.model_id = #{modelId}
SELECT id, host, state, idc_id, cabinet_id, model_id FROM asset
